_comment: Nepal-passport-specific entry facts for every destination the passport-index dataset lists as visa-free or visa-on-arrival for NP. Overrides the dataset's status where Nepal-specific rules differ, and replaces the generic per-destination fee/maxStay in destination-requirements.json. status uses the passport-index vocabulary (visa_free | visa_on_arrival | evisa | sticker_visa). confidence: 'confirmed' = Nepal-specific source found; 'unconfirmed' = sources missing or disagree, so the UI tells travelers to check first. Re-check these whenever the weekly passport-index sync changes an NP->* pair.

conditions: Complete the Barbados online Immigration & Customs form within 72 hours before arrival.
Travelers report an entry clearance that may need to be arranged through your airline or host before flying. Confirm with Gambia Immigration or your airline.

HT.fee: No visa fee ($10 tourist fee at the airport)
conditions: Register on Haiti's iKat electronic entry form at least 72 hours before arrival.
Check your government's travel advisory first; Haiti has serious security warnings.
Carry your passport or Nepali citizenship certificate. Airlines ask for one of these on flights to India.
Visa-free ONLY if you hold a valid visa or residence permit from the US, UK, a Schengen country, Japan, Australia, Canada or Singapore. Without one, apply for a visa at a Philippine embassy first.
Register on eTravel (etravel.gov.ph) within 72 hours before arrival.
Pakistan changed its online visa programme in January 2026. Confirm with the Pakistan Embassy in Kathmandu or your airline before booking.

PS.stayText: As granted on your Israeli visa
conditions: The Palestinian territories can only be entered through Israeli-controlled crossings, and Nepali citizens need an Israeli visa from the Embassy of Israel in Kathmandu.

SC.fee: Visitor's Permit free; online Travel Authorisation fee applies
conditions: Apply for the Seychelles Travel Authorisation online before you fly.
On arrival you need a return ticket, confirmed accommodation and proof of funds.
Submit the free SG Arrival Card online within 3 days before arrival.
Free for tourists under a reciprocal arrangement with Nepal.
The e-visa at migration.gov.bi is cheaper than the visa on arrival.
Nepal is in Bolivia's Group 3: apply at a Bolivian embassy before travel (no visa on arrival). Group 3 also needs prior authorization from Bolivia's migration office (SENAMIG).
Cape Verde ended visa on arrival for 96 nationalities on 1 January 2026, apparently including Nepal. Get a visa from a Cape Verdean embassy before travel, and complete the EASE pre-registration.
Djibouti recommends applying for the e-visa at evisa.gouv.dj before travel.
Egypt's e-visa is not open to Nepali passports; get the visa at the airport on arrival.
Sources disagree on whether Nepalis can get a visa on arrival. Ghana launched an official e-visa portal in May 2026; apply there before travel to be safe.
Guinea-Bissau now mainly issues e-visas; apply online before travel rather than relying on a visa on arrival.
The fee depends on nationality; confirm the rate for Nepali passports with the Iranian Embassy in Kathmandu.
Pay in cash (euros or US dollars). Foreign bank cards do not work in Iran.
Also available online as an e-visa (tourist visa T) at evisa.gov.kh.
Pay in US dollars or euros.
Available at major airports and land borders, or as an e-visa at laoevisa.gov.la.
Apply for the free ETA online at eta.gov.lk before you fly (double entry, 30 days).
An e-visa with the same length-based fees is also available.
Since January 2025 you must get e-visa approval from anrpts.gov.mr before boarding; the fee is paid in exact cash at the airport.
Fill in the Mauritius digital travel form before departure and show its QR code on arrival.
Submit the free IMUGA traveller declaration within 96 hours before arrival (and again before departure).
Have confirmed accommodation and a return ticket.
Nepal is not on Mozambique's visa-exempt list; get the Electronic Travel Authorization before travel.
Nepal is on Palau's excluded list: get a visa or written pre-clearance from Palau's Bureau of Customs and Border Protection before travel (apply at least 5 days ahead).
Can also be applied for online at irembo.gov.rw.
Have a return ticket and proof of accommodation.
Pay in cash at Dili airport.
Have a return ticket, proof of accommodation and sufficient funds.
Tanzania recommends the e-visa at visa.immigration.go.tz (apply 15+ days ahead); visa on arrival is paid in US dollar notes.
Samoa requires some nationalities to get an online entry authorization before departure, and sources don't say whether Nepal is one of them. Check with Samoa Immigration before booking.
